CustomField.description: How long CursorBatch_Event_Ledger__c rows are kept. Blank uses the framework default of 7 days. This must exceed the longest replay the event bus could deliver: the 2026-08-24 incident replayed events 103 hours old on a channel whose documented retention is 24 hours, so a value below about 5 days leaves a window in which a replay finds no marker and is admitted.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Days of event ledger history to keep. Blank uses 7. Values below 5 risk missing a long replay.
CustomField.label: Ledger Retention (days)
